source.version: abstract only (Crossref API; SSRN working paper, 2026)
source.title_on_document: When Everyone Gets the Same Spark: How AI Inspiration Shapes Creative Diversity in the Creator Economy

paper_design_summary: The abstract describes difference-in-differences models on a matched panel of incumbent YouTube creators, exploiting regional variation in access to the Inspiration Tab between U.S. and European creators. The tool suggests video ideas, hooks, and storylines; the study assesses realized video production, semantic and topical similarity to creators’ own prior output, similarity across creators, and downstream views. Only the abstract was accessible, so sample sizes, observation periods, model specifications, analysis units, and detailed diversity estimates could not be confirmed (Crossref API abstract for DOI 10.2139/ssrn.6910898 (https://api.crossref.org/works/10.2139%2Fssrn.6910898)).

eligibility.reason: The complete accessible Crossref abstract describes an observational regional-access difference-in-differences study on a matched panel of incumbent YouTube creators. Criterion 3 is met: semantic and topical similarity is assessed on realized videos, both against each creator’s prior output and across creators. The abstract does not report random assignment of people or a participant count, so criteria 1 and 2 remain unclear and core eligibility is not established. The paper remains observational context (Crossref API abstract for DOI 10.2139/ssrn.6910898 (https://api.crossref.org/works/10.2139%2Fssrn.6910898), sentences beginning 'Exploiting regional variation' and 'Consistent, treated creators'). No full text is on file (retrieval.json, c604: not_obtained); full-text methods, additional studies, and disclosures could not be checked.

one_line_finding: The abstract reports that Inspiration Tab access increased video production by 4.1%, reduced within-creator semantic and topical diversity, and did not increase similarity across creators (Crossref abstract, DOI 10.2139/ssrn.6910898).

applied.quote: Consistent, treated creators’ videos become more similar to their own prior output along semantic and topical dimensions, reducing within-creator diversity; however, their output does not become more similar to other creators’ output.
